sections.instructions: List relevant evidence before deciding what best supports the claim.
sections.label: Candidate Evidence / Data

sections.instructions: State a defensible answer to the question or problem.
sections.label: CLAIM

sections.instructions: Identify the strongest evidence supporting the claim.
sections.label: EVIDENCE

sections.instructions: Explain why the evidence supports the claim using scientific ideas or principles.
sections.label: REASONING

sections.instructions: Record a question, counterexample, limitation, or alternative explanation raised by peers.
sections.label: Peer Challenge / Question

sections.instructions: Revise or qualify the claim or reasoning after discussion.
sections.label: REVISION
